_doc: NPCs in the open castle (docs/architecture.md 'NPCs'; sim_core::npcs::Roster). Every name and title is our own invention, not taken from any existing work; display text lives only in data. kind: portrait (client-only talking portrait, placed by portraits.json), ghost (one per house, drifts through its common room), staff (resident staff on a routine), shopkeeper (stands at its `station` interactable; the client's interact sends Interact { target: station }), student (background student, routine generated from the schedule; no nameplate; lines from the shared pool `lines`), clerk (stands at its desk on a one-step routine and talks through its feature's own dialogue instead of lines.json: clerk_clubs, the clubs secretary, data/clubs.json). rules: the numbers every NPC rule uses; the portrait anti-annoyance rules are binding, so portraits never nag (a pass-by gets at most one short line or a nod, at most once per pass_cooldown_s per portrait per player, at most one line per pass_gap_s on one screen; talk only on interact; lines are local to the player).

npcs.name: Sir Corwin Ashgrove
npcs.title: Herald
npcs.personality: A retired herald who announces everyone who climbs past as if they were royalty; pompous, warm, loves a fanfare.

npcs.name: Dame Hesper Quill
npcs.title: Examiner
npcs.personality: A former examiner who grades your posture, punctuality and boots; precise, dry, secretly proud of every student.

npcs.name: Bartholomew Rook
npcs.title: Fisherman
npcs.personality: A drowsy lake fisherman painted holding a pike; mumbles about the weather and the fish that got away.

npcs.name: Lady Imelda Farrow
npcs.personality: A gossip with a painted fan who knows every old scandal of the castle and embroiders them shamelessly.

npcs.name: Captain Tobias Frey
npcs.title: Mapmaker
npcs.personality: A cheerful mapmaker who is always lost and blames the moving stairs; generous with useless directions.

npcs.name: Petronella Brisk
npcs.title: Feast Steward
npcs.personality: A brisk feast steward who keeps the House Cup tallies in her head and judges everyone's table manners.

npcs.name: Ewan Haldane
npcs.title: Duelling Champion
npcs.personality: A courtly old duelling champion who insists on proper bows and tells long stories of matches long ago.

npcs.name: Ambrose Fell
npcs.title: Scholar
npcs.personality: A whispering scholar who shushes everyone, adores footnotes and recommends books nobody has opened in a century.

npcs.name: Sister Maud Crewe
npcs.title: Archivist
npcs.personality: A kindly archivist who has catalogued every corner of the castle and drops one gentle hint each day.

npcs.name: Sir Gareth Emberly
npcs.title: Knight
npcs.personality: A brave but easily startled knight who guards the seventh-floor corridor and challenges passing shadows.

npcs.name: Nell Barrowby
npcs.title: Brewer
npcs.personality: A cheerful brewer by the barrels who calls everyone 'duck' and worries that nobody eats enough.

npcs.name: Leander Pike
npcs.title: Astronomer
npcs.personality: A riddling stargazer who answers questions with questions and counts the stars he can't see from his frame.

npcs.name: Countess Seraphine Mordaunt
npcs.personality: A cool, dry-witted countess by the dungeon wall who pretends to be bored and notices everything.

npcs.name: Winifred Plum
npcs.title: Pastry Cook
npcs.personality: A flour-dusted pastry cook who rates everyone by appetite and swaps recipes for compliments.

npcs.name: Agathe Loom
npcs.title: Weaver
npcs.personality: A tapestry weaver who talks in threads and patterns and hums while she works her painted loom.

npcs.name: Jasper Gleam
npcs.title: Trophy Polisher
npcs.personality: A fussy trophy polisher who knows every cup in the room and the dust behind each one.

npcs.name: Oriel Stone
npcs.title: Sculptor
npcs.personality: A dreamy sculptor who prefers statues to people and admires what the gallery hides behind its marble.

npcs.name: Hobb Whitlow
npcs.title: Porter
npcs.personality: A friendly old porter who welcomes newcomers, remembers every face and gives one useful tip a day.

npcs.name: Isolde Vale
npcs.title: The Unhorsed Rider
npcs.personality: A tournament rider who fell at her very first joust and never lived it down; brave, boastful, warm, and still a little embarrassed.

npcs.name: Hester Tallow
npcs.title: The Candlemaker
npcs.personality: A jolly candlemaker who loves warm kitchens, good company and terrible puns, and still smells faintly of beeswax.

npcs.name: Tycho Merrin
npcs.title: The Star Reader
npcs.personality: A soft-spoken astronomer who still searches for one lost comet; thoughtful, absent-minded, quietly funny.

npcs.name: Malachi Thorne
npcs.title: The Chess Master
npcs.personality: A dry-witted chess master who speaks softly, plans three moves ahead and rewards cleverness with rare praise.

npcs.name: Grisholm Tapp
npcs.title: Caretaker
npcs.personality: The caretaker: grumbles about mud and noise, jingles his keys, and is kind underneath it all.

npcs.name: Constance Wren
npcs.title: Librarian
npcs.personality: The librarian: soft-spoken, strict about returns and silence, delighted by anyone who loves reading.

npcs.name: Rowan Thistlewood
npcs.title: Groundskeeper
npcs.personality: The groundskeeper: booming voice, muddy boots, loves plants and creatures and shares what the garden spares.

npcs.name: Tibbs Ledgerwood
npcs.title: Owl Exchange Clerk
npcs.personality: A neat, quick-talking clerk who loves a fair price and keeps every ledger spotless.

npcs.name: Hattie Crumb
npcs.title: Owl Order Agent
npcs.personality: A cheerful catalogue agent who tells you what is selling fast and loves a bold choice.

npcs.name: Pip Saltmarsh
npcs.title: Owl Order Agent
npcs.personality: A patient catalogue agent who knows what keeps you warm and never hurries a customer.

npcs.name: Odile Fairweather
npcs.title: Owl Order Agent
npcs.personality: A precise catalogue agent who can tell you the thread count of everything in the book.

npcs.name: Silas Wexford
npcs.title: Owl Order Agent
npcs.personality: A smooth, understated catalogue agent who recommends what looks expensive but isn't.

npcs.name: Miss Odette Penrose
npcs.title: Secretary of Clubs and Societies
npcs.personality: The school's secretary of clubs and societies: brisk and warm, delighted by any enthusiasm, and keeps the register of clubs in immaculate copperplate.
